messages:
Alex: RC assembled: artifact 3.2.0-rc4 is built and pushed. Requesting final go/no-go for PROD push window (09:00-11:00 PST).
Sam: QA smoke passed. Found one tiny prompt-truncation regression fixed in patch, release notes updated.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: artifact 3.2.0-rc4 uploaded to registry. Canary schedule pre-seeded. Promote command: `/promote rc=3.2.0-rc4 env=prod window=09:00-11:00`
Jordan: Quick check: any DB migrations? Need to ensure we don’t accidentally run schema work.
Maria: No DB migrations. Change is config-only (redis ttl tweak). I can pin redis params if needed.
Alex: Rollout plan: wave1 10% @09:15, wave2 50% @09:30, wave3 100% @09:50. Abort criteria: p50 > 60ms for 10m OR error-rate > 0.5%. Rollback = revert to 3.1.x pin + scale down.
Dana: Ops confirmed oncall for the window. I’ll execute promote when Alex says go.
Sam: One watch item: embed-service p50 +10ms in canary, telemetry says within expected range after quantization tweak. Marking as monitor-only.
Alex: Acceptable. Monitoring hooks set: dashboards + alert @ops if thresholds tripped.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: running pre-promotion checks... all checks PASS. Canary hosts healthy. Please confirm readiness to execute `/promote`.
Jordan: ready
Maria: ready
Dana: ready
Sam: ready (QA)
Alex: Go for promote.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: executing `/promote rc=3.2.0-rc4 -> prod`. Wave1 (10%) started.
Alex: wave1 smoke: no errors, latency stable so far.
Sam: observability: kv-warm hits increasing, no 5xx spikes.
Maria: redis latencies look normal.
Jordan: wave2 (50%) started.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: wave2 ramp to 50% complete.
Dana: Ops: running post-wave checks, error budgets clear.
Alex: Holding on wave3 until post-wave metrics steady for 5m.
Sam: 5m green, traces look consistent.
Alex: wave3 (100%) go.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: promoted to 3.2.0 at full prod. Release notes URL: https://internal/release/3.2.0 
Sam: Nice work :tada: Will watch telemetry for next 30m.
Jordan: If anything pops, I'll spin a follow-up thread and schedule a quick retro.
Maria: I left the redis pin command in #infra-runbooks in case we need immediate rollback.
Dana: Ops acknowledged.
Alex: noted — thanks everyone.
